text: {"text":"A migration changed the names of three public fields and, at the same time, retained compatibility aliases for them. Twelve of fourteen known clients have migrated, which is substantial progress, while the status of the other two clients remains unknown. Integration tests cover the twelve migrated clients but do not cover the two clients whose status is unknown. Therefore, the evidence supports continuing the migration work, but it does not support removing the aliases. Do not remove the aliases until the owners of the two remaining clients confirm that they have migrated."}
